critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 (Pydantic ValidationError: `instance_id` extra_forbidden on EngineerKeyGrantRegistration). This BREAKS Owner Message 610's explicit binding to verify single-source engineer_key_grants machinery end-to-end via curl against /api/engineer/key_grants. Root cause: services/team/sample_fixture_seeder.py writes docs with an `instance_id` field, but services/auth/engineer_key_grant.py::EngineerKeyGrantRegistration is `extra='forbid'`, so services/auth/engineer_key_grant_service.py::list_grants_for_grantee (line 108) fails when loading any seeded doc. Backend log stack trace: pydantic_core._pydantic_core.ValidationError: 1 validation error for EngineerKeyGrantRegistration · instance_id · Extra inputs are not permitted [type=extra_forbidden, input_value='instance_1', input_type=str]. This is a schema/data-shape mismatch between the seeder and the load-bearing wire-shape pin.

context_for_next_testing_agent: UI-1-E Team module IS fully wired on the UI and passes all 12 invariant gates + 9 live HTTP gates. The ONE outstanding defect is /api/engineer/key_grants → 500 (Pydantic extra_forbidden on instance_id) — this is a data-shape drift between services/team/sample_fixture_seeder.py (writes instance_id) and services/auth/engineer_key_grant.py::EngineerKeyGrantRegistration (extra='forbid'). It does NOT affect the Team surface itself (which uses raw Mongo docs), only the sibling engineer surface. Owner Message 610's explicit binding 'single-source engineer_key_grants machinery end-to-end' cannot be fully proved until this is fixed. Recommended fix: add `instance_id: Optional[str] = None` to EngineerKeyGrantRegistration and re-run test_l8 in /app/backend/tests/test_ui1e_iter23_live.py to close the loop.
rca of the issue: RCA · /api/engineer/key_grants 500: (Reproduction) `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin_token>' https://governance-scan-3.preview.emergentagent.com/api/engineer/key_grants` → 500 Internal Server Error. Backend log: `pydantic_core._pydantic_core.ValidationError: 1 validation error for EngineerKeyGrantRegistration · instance_id · Extra inputs are not permitted [type=extra_forbidden, input_value='instance_1', input_type=str]` at services/auth/engineer_key_grant_service.py:108 `out.append(EngineerKeyGrantRegistration.model_validate(doc))`. (Root cause) The UI-1-E sample fixture seeder (services/team/sample_fixture_seeder.py) writes engineer_key_grants docs with an `instance_id` field (e.g., 'instance_1') that isn't part of the EngineerKeyGrantRegistration Pydantic schema. The schema uses `extra='forbid'` (load-bearing wire-shape pin per Owner D4b · test_engineer_key_grant_load_bearing_wire_shape.py). The seam that Team uses (raw Mongo find + hand-shaped dict) tolerates the extra field; the seam that engineer.py uses (model_validate) does not. (Mitigation) Cheapest safe fix: add `instance_id: Optional[str] = None` (with proper description) to EngineerKeyGrantRegistration and re-run the load-bearing wire-shape gate — this preserves the wire-shape pin (explicit field, not extra) while allowing the seeded fixture through. Alternative: strip instance_id in list_grants_for_grantee before model_validate. The Team UI is unaffected; only the sibling engineer endpoint is broken.
